nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner, set in Owned constructor and compared against msg.sender in _onlyOwner.
Address of the pending owner nomination, written by nominateNewOwner and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Proxy contract used by Proxyable to authorise proxy calls; mutable via setProxy.
Secondary proxy contract accepted as a valid caller; mutable via setIntegrationProxy.
Cached original caller passed through by the proxy; written by setMessageSender and _optionalProxy helpers.
Proxyable implementation target; set by setTarget and used by the fallback and all ERC20 forwarding calls.
External onlyOwner function that records a new nominated owner.
External function that requires msg.sender == nominatedOwner and transfers ownership.
External onlyOwner function that updates the proxy reference.
External onlyOwner function that updates the integration proxy reference.
External onlyProxy function that stores the original caller into messageSender.
External onlyOwner function on Proxy that updates the target implementation.
External onlyTarget function that emits logs with raw assembly log0-log4 opcodes.
Payable fallback of Proxy that forwards the raw calldata with a low-level call and returns the raw returndata.
ERC20 transfer that first pushes msg.sender into the target and then forwards the call.
ERC20 approve that first pushes msg.sender into the target and then forwards the call.
ERC20 transferFrom that first pushes msg.sender into the target and then forwards the call.
Private view guard requiring msg.sender == owner.
Private view guard requiring msg.sender to equal proxy or integrationProxy.
Private helper that refreshes messageSender and then requires messageSender == owner.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, proxy checks and messageSender propagation.
Assembly call in Proxy fallback forwarding gas and value to the target, then reverting or returning raw returndata.
External mutable call target.setMessageSender(msg.sender) performed by the ERC20 forwarding functions.
Assembly log0-log4 emission over caller-supplied calldata in Proxy._emit, guarded only by onlyTarget.
Parameter _owner of nominateNewOwner, the candidate nominated owner.
Parameter _target of setTarget, the new implementation contract.
Parameter sender of setMessageSender, the propagated original caller.
Parameter to of transfer/transferFrom, the recipient address.
Parameter value of transfer/approve/transferFrom, the token amount.
Parameter spender of approve, the allowance beneficiary.
Parameter from of transferFrom, the token holder address.
Parameter numTopics of _emit selecting the log opcode to use.

edges.reason: acceptOwnership authorises on msg.sender being the nominated owner, an externally controlled address.
_onlyOwner compares msg.sender to owner to gate privileged functions.
_onlyProxy compares msg.sender to proxy and integrationProxy to authorise callers.
Fallback uses msg.sender for the setMessageSender propagation and forwards it to the target.
transfer forwards msg.sender into target.setMessageSender before executing the token transfer.
approve forwards msg.sender into target.setMessageSender before executing the approval.
transferFrom forwards msg.sender into target.setMessageSender before executing the transfer.
_emit trusts msg.sender as the onlyTarget caller and never validates the topic values.
The fallback forwards the whole calldata with a low-level call, giving the target full control before the proxy completes.
The fallback reads the target slot to determine the call destination.
The fallback writes messageSender on the target before forwarding the call.
The fallback triggers the mutable target.setMessageSender external interaction.
transfer performs the mutable external call target.setMessageSender before the token transfer.
approve performs the mutable external call target.setMessageSender before the approval.
transferFrom performs the mutable external call target.setMessageSender before the transfer.
The external setMessageSender call writes the messageSender state variable.
transfer reads the target slot to place the forwarded ERC20 call.
approve reads the target slot to place the forwarded ERC20 call.
transferFrom reads the target slot to place the forwarded ERC20 call.
setTarget writes the target implementation reference.
setProxy writes the proxy reference.
setIntegrationProxy writes the integrationProxy reference.
setMessageSender writes the cached caller address.
setMessageSender is guarded by the onlyProxy modifier implemented by _onlyProxy.
nominateNewOwner uses the onlyOwner modifier backed by _onlyOwner and owner.
acceptOwnership reads nominatedOwner for the authorisation check.
acceptOwnership assigns nominatedOwner into owner, transferring ownership.
nominateNewOwner writes the nominatedOwner state variable.
_optionalProxy_onlyOwner refreshes messageSender when msg.sender is unknown.
_optionalProxy_onlyOwner requires messageSender == owner as its authorisation condition.
_emit reaches the assembly log0-log4 opcode block that emits arbitrary caller-supplied data.
_emit is restricted by onlyTarget, which compares msg.sender to the target slot.
The _owner parameter flows into the nominatedOwner assignment.
The _target parameter flows into the target assignment.
The sender parameter flows into the messageSender assignment.
The to parameter is forwarded to the target ERC20 transfer call.
The value parameter is forwarded to the target ERC20 transfer call.
The spender parameter is forwarded to the target ERC20 approve call.
The from parameter is forwarded to the target ERC20 transferFrom call.
numTopics selects which assembly log opcode _emit executes.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _owner is only used to set nominatedOwner inside nominateNewOwner and has no independent semantics.
Parameter _target is only used to set the target state variable inside setTarget.
Parameter sender is only used to set messageSender inside setMessageSender.
Parameter to is only forwarded by transfer to the target ERC20 call.
Parameter value is only forwarded by transfer to the target ERC20 call.
Parameter spender is only forwarded by approve to the target ERC20 call.
Parameter from is only forwarded by transferFrom to the target ERC20 call.
Parameter numTopics only selects the assembly log opcode inside _emit.
